framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure of change in shareholding above the threshold (5% for first disclosure; 2% thereafter); triggers open offer or exemption analysis.
Exemption from open offer for acquirers meeting specified conditions (e.g. creeping acquisition, intra-group transfers, rights offerings).
Open offer trigger: if acquirer holds ≥25% or acquires 5%+ of shares in a single transaction, acquirer must make an open offer at floor price to remaining shareholders.
Definition of 'acquirer' and 'person acting in concert'; critical to determine if Chaman Lal Brijrani Charitale Trust acts alone or with related parties.

Regulation of insider trading and disclosure of changes in shareholding; cross-reference with Schedule III (Board Report disclosure obligations).
If acquisition was preceded by material non-public information in the hands of Trust officers or board members, insider trading liability may arise.

headline: Chaman Lal Brijrani Charitale Trust files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: The Chaman Lal Brijrani Charitale Trust submitted a mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in Asian Hotels (West) Limited, the listed hospitality company.
detail: The Chaman Lal Brijrani Charitale Trust, likely a pre-existing substantial shareholder or newly crossing the 5% threshold, filed a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Asian Hotels (West) Limited operates premium hospitality assets and is listed on NSE. The filing is a regulatory gating point: depending on the acquirer's total holding post-disclosure and stated intent, an open offer under Regulation 4, exemption under Regulation 3, or creeping acquisition tracking under Regulation 31(2) may follow. The specific share quantity and acquisition price are not disclosed in the regulatory notice itself.
